name: Foundry
source: TSMC Q1 FY2026, Intel Q2 FY2026, Samsung Q1 FY2026

tables.title: Leading-edge node roadmap
rows: N2 in HVM since Q4 2025 (good yield, Hsinchu+Kaohsiung) -> N2P -> A16 -> A14 (2nd-gen nanosheet, +10-15% speed / 25-30% power / ~20% density vs N2, VP 2028)
Intel 3 -> 18A (Xeon 6+ = first server product on 18A) -> 18A-P in RISK PRODUCTION -> 14A (design commits 2026-27); Panther Lake in HVM on ASML EXE High-NA EUV

tables.title: Advanced packaging
rows: Largest-reticle CoWoS today; CoPoS pilot line now, production ~2028; SoIC; capacity very tight — OSAT partners enlisted
Foveros / EMIB backlog $B/yr; Malaysia back-end revenue 2027; dedicated advanced-packaging leader appointed (Seok-Hee Lee); Fortinet SP6 design+packaging win
I-Cube / X-Cube; HBM4 base die on 4nm

tables.title: Capacity & fabs

EUR5B expansion for Xeon 6 / next-gen Xeon on Intel 3; Bowers campus mask-operations expansion; investment 'meaningfully increasing' in equipment, clean room and substrates; 2026 tool spend +~25% YoY
